cacheHitRateTooltip: Cached input tokens divided by total input tokens in the latest displayed usage snapshot. This is the cached share of input tokens, not a count of request-level cache-hit events; -- is shown when no input tokens are available.
contextUnavailable: This task did not report a context-window size, so usage cannot be calculated.
estimatedCostTooltip: An API-list-price equivalent, not a subscription bill, actual charge, or exact credits. Monitoring and cache metrics accept any model name; cost uses exact IDs, aliases, and dated snapshots from the local catalog. A completely new or unknown price safely shows -- instead of borrowing an old model's price. When Work and Codex share an agentic allowance, this HUD still sees only local Codex sessions.
behaviorHint: Keep task interaction, quiet-time reduction, and context safeguards together without crowding the HUD.
taskNavigationHint: Use Codex's supported task deep link; no window automation or session-file writes.
openTaskOnDoubleClick: Double-click a task row or independent bubble to open it in Codex
openTaskTooltip: Double-click to open this task in Codex
idleIndicatorHint: After a long quiet period, retract to one overall light or a numbered row/column of task lights. Hover or new activity expands it immediately.
idleIndicatorEnabled: Retract to the status light when quiet
contextAlertsHint: Defaults are 75%, 90%, and 98%. Enter one to three whole percentages from 1–99 in any order; duplicates are removed and saved from low to high.
contextMetricVisible: Show context usage in detached bubbles (always shown in the list; required for alerts)
contextDependencyEnabled: Context usage is now visible and alerts are enabled.
contextDependencyDisabled: Context alerts were turned off because context usage is hidden.
contextThresholdsInvalid: Enter one to three whole percentages from 1 to 99.
multiTaskExplanation: Summary keeps the HUD compact. List mode uses stable task numbers and keeps conversation names visible. Split mode creates independent task bubbles. Weekly allowance stays account-wide on the summary bubble only.
autoSplitNewTasks: Auto-split new tasks while in split mode
listDetailHint: Tiers follow operator priority. Model and context are always visible; Detailed wraps diagnostics onto a second line.
listDetailCompact: Compact: status, model, context, and cache hit rate
listDetailDetailed: Detailed: second line adds input mix, output, task total, window, cost, and time
taskBubbleResizeHint: Drag the lower-right corner of any independent bubble to resize it. Its fields are separate from the list.
dismissTask: Remove from HUD; it returns when this conversation runs again
closeTaskBubble: Close only this detached bubble; monitoring continues in the main HUD
sessionSourcesHint: Task rows use compact source icons only; hover an icon for its full name. The controls below let you monitor each source independently.
sourceDefaultCliOption: Codex CLI — default profile (usually OpenAI / GPT)
sessionSourcesPrivacy: Read-only: the HUD reads only sessions and session_index.jsonl. It never reads or changes provider configuration, API keys, authentication, prompts, replies, or archives.
sourceBreakdownTooltip: Visible tasks grouped by Codex client and provider
agentNotificationHint: Allow Codex to show a short plain-text notice when it genuinely needs you to return. Off by default; its card, color, and motion are separate from automatic completion/error reminders. Maximum 160 characters; no links, rich text, or scripts.
agentNotificationEnabled: Allow proactive Codex notices (off by default)
agentNotificationTooltip: When enabled, Codex can call monitor_hud_notify with short plain text. Safe live choreography also lets Codex combine bounded glow, pulse, breathe, flow, color, tempo and cycles without executing code. Summary shows the source number; list/split mode affects only the matching task.
attentionHint: Put motion only on the task that actually needs you back.
attentionTooltip: Codex task_complete marks the end of one turn, not permanent completion of the whole conversation. The HUD ignores silent endings with no visible final message and waits 8 seconds to confirm that another turn did not immediately start. It does not read or analyze your message text.
attentionRoutingTooltip: Summary mode reacts only on the summary bubble. List mode reacts only on the matching task row. Split or detached mode reacts only on the matching independent bubble; other tasks stay still.
dotAttentionHint: Flash pattern, brightness and subtle scale breathing are independent. This reminder stays hidden when the status dot is disabled in Appearance.
attentionCompletedTooltip: Remind after one Codex turn has finished producing visible output and has not immediately resumed within 8 seconds. This can mean that your review or input is needed; it does not mean the entire conversation goal is complete.
attentionAbortedOrErrorTooltip: Remind when Codex explicitly aborts or the HUD temporarily cannot read new session data.
attentionSettledTooltip: Infers quiet from a period with no new tokens and can mistake a thinking gap for an ending. Disabled by default to reduce false positives.
presetsHint: Choose a polished starting point, then tune it to your workflow.
themeWorkshopHint: Drop a theme file here to validate and install it. Updates will not overwrite it.
themeWorkshopTooltip: Supports declarative .json / .cmhud-theme files and .cmhud-theme.zip packs with local PNG/JPG background assets. Scripts and network resources are never loaded.
terminalExitHint: After retention ends, only the corresponding list row or detached bubble plays this bounded departure animation.
metricsHint: Only totals that remain meaningful across tasks, active count, and account allowances belong here. Model, context, cache hit rate, task total, and updated time are per-task data shown in the list or detached bubbles. Cached input is part of input.
pricingSourceHint: Estimates cumulative task tokens from public API text prices; it is not a subscription bill or actual credits. New models remain fully monitored without a code update. Unknown prices show --; dated snapshots automatically reuse a matching catalog model. Blank uses the bundled snapshot, or select a compatible local pricing file.
pricingPathTooltip: Compatible with codex-usage-tracker-pricing-v1: model entries use USD per million input, cached-input and output tokens, with optional aliases. Only local JSON is read; no network request is made.
transparencyHint: Uniform opacity applies the slider to the whole bubble; 100% is fully opaque. Layered clarity visibly fades the shell while keeping numbers and status crisp. Smart focus is faint when idle, then strengthens during activity or reminders.
mousePassthroughHint: When enabled, the HUD no longer receives mouse input. Use the desktop/Start settings shortcut or ask Codex to disable click-through.
mousePassthroughConfirm: You will not be able to drag, double-click or right-click the HUD while click-through is enabled. The settings window will stay open as an immediate recovery path; later, use the settings shortcut or ask Codex to disable it.
animateUpdatesTooltip: Uses a subtle fade only when tasks, display mode, or status phase really changes. Token counter refreshes never flash the whole window.
statusPalettesHint: A scheme changes the seven status colors; every color remains individually editable. Completion uses green, while abort and error demand attention.
statusPaletteCodexMicroSource: Codex Micro reference values were sampled from OpenAI's public Codex Micro page. They are local visual references only; OpenAI does not endorse this project, and device, display, color-management, accessibility, and theme differences can prevent a match with the page or hardware lighting.
